_comment: Kitsoki onboarding tour, ported to the slidey capture engine (was tools/runstatus/tests/playwright/tour-video.spec.ts + src/tour/manifest.ts). Run: (1) build kitsoki: `make build && cp ./kitsoki bin/kitsoki`; (2) `PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=... slidey capture examples/demos/kitsoki-onboarding-tour.json out.mp4` (set cwd/launch to your kitsoki checkout). Produces out.mp4 + out.mp4.chapters.json — drop into a `video` scene with chapters:auto. Steps + dwellMs mirror features/onboarding-tour.yaml.
